title: GPCRact: hierarchical prediction of ligand-induced GPCR activity (software, weights and data)
description:
Source code, trained model weights and data for GPCRact, a hierarchical framework for predicting ligand-induced GPCR activity via allosteric communication modeling (Son and Yi, Briefings in Bioinformatics 2026, doi:10.1093/bib/bbaf719).

Licences: source code MIT; trained weights (checkpoints/) CC BY-NC 4.0; data (data/) CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; modified third-party baselines retain their original licences (benchmarks/DeepREAL CC BY-NC 4.0, benchmarks/AiGPro AGPL-3.0). See NOTICE in the archive.
